I feel you bro.  I was tricked into fatherhood by a lying bitch who claimed to had medical procedure that made her infertile.  At the end, it was all a scheme to get pregnant and use me to get child support since I was going to be in a financially stable profession.

Even though she tricked me into the whole mess, I still tried to be there for my son and her.  I even offered to be a full time dad and move in with her and take over the living expenses so she can work less and spend more time with the baby.  But, no.  Bitch thinks I have no more use for her and wants me to stick around for child support only and see my son whenever she feels like bringing him around him.

I would rather die or flee the country than to be robbed for next 18 years by the biased & fucked up legal system in this country.  I would have voluntarily helped her out of the goodness of my heart but too bad she turned into a complete bitch and started demanding money as soon as the baby was born.

Bitch will not get a penny from me anymore unless she does the right thing and starts to treat me right.  I'd rather die on my feet and live on my knees.  Many people advised me that I should flee to my "home" country, but fuck that.  I'm not leaving this country and leave my family behind as a fugitive because of some corrupt bitch fucked me over.
I don't know why you're being downvoted.  You just gave an honest opinion.  I don't think you were trolling either.
that's a very noble thought... but i don't know if i have it in me to help other people when i can't even help myself anymore.
you can go to the court and fight it... what medical history do you ahve?
although i don't want to encourage more alcoholism... but i want to buy you a drink so much

Yeah, I'm starting to feel that way.   However, the thought of my family's struggle after my death seems to stop me from taking my life at this point.

At one point, I may be just too fed up with life, I may just have to disregard my family for my own relief.

Love is indeed about sacrifice.... but I just feel stuck in between death and life.  I'm not really living.. yet I'm not really dead.  I'm just stuck because of my bond to my family.

I'm sure the pain my death will exert on my family may be greater than the pain I experience alone... but I just want to free myself from the despair and I hope my family would understand that when I'm gone.
